name: High Tide Resources Corp.
summary: High Tide Resources Corp. engages in the acquisition, exploration, and development of mineral property interests in Canada. The company primarily acquires and explores for iron ores, copper, nickel, and cobalt sulphide deposits, as well as electric vehicle battery metals. Its flagship project is the Labrador West iron project covering a total area of 2,475 hectares located in Labrador Trough, Canada. The company was incorporated in 2018 and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.
